mainEntity.name: When do IELTS Speaking topics change?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Speaking question pool partially refreshes roughly every four months — around January, May and September. Part of the topics are retired and new ones enter; the format never changes.

mainEntity.name: Are the 'current Speaking topics' lists official?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. IELTS never publishes its live question bank. Lists circulating online are reconstructed from test-taker reports — useful for practice, but never a guarantee. The reliable strategy is preparing flexible stories that adapt to any cue card.

The opening frame is stable: Work or Study, Home/Accommodation, and Hometown — one of these starts almost every interview. Common rotating Part 1 topics include weather, food, friends, music, sport, books, transport and technology.
